An '''agent''' for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operated in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]<ref name="Wanted" /> around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="WC Dates">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is set three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], meaning ''Wanted by Cracken'' is set in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> While in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], he intercepted a scrambled transmission from one of the system's [[Planet/Legends|planets]], which contained plans for a new [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] in development by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Gen Tiraan]]. Both the sublight engine and Tiraan were of interest to the New Republic and remnants of the [[Galactic Empire]], and the transmission noted that Tiraan was being hounded by Imperial forces attempting to leverage him into the Imperial service.<ref name="Wanted" />

{{RPGseed}}
When a team of Republic operatives arrived in the Corellian system in search of Tiraan, the agent provided the transmission to the group so that they could locate and rescue Tiraan before he was forcibly taken by Imperial forces.<ref name="Wanted" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The agent was mentioned in Gen Tiraan's entry within [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a [[1993]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]].<ref name="Wanted" />
